# search_public_pages

Usage: search published pages by title, summary, tags, categories, and canonical URL.

Endpoint: `https://mcp.arleo.eu/mcp`

Inputs:
- query string

Outputs:
- matched public page summaries

Security:
- read-only
- no auth
- no writes

Limitations:
- index-based only
